title: Five
summary: 离线五子棋，支持 Rapfi 人机和同机双人。 Offline Gomoku with Rapfi or local two-player.
description:
简体中文
在 Cardputer Zero 上离线下五子棋。与 Rapfi 对弈可选简单、普通或困难，也可在同一台设备上两人轮流落子。支持 15×15 和 13×13 棋盘，以及自由规则和连珠禁手。两种对局均支持悔棋和续局。界面和规则说明均支持简体中文和英文。

最近改动（1.0.0-7）
Rapfi 落子失败后，Five 会自动重试。连续失败时，重试间隔从 0.5 秒逐步增加到 4 秒。重试期间仍可悔棋或返回菜单。

Five 应用部分采用专有许可。Rapfi 是独立引擎，按 GPL-3.0-or-later 分发，官方模型权重采用 CC0-1.0。安装包内的 /usr/share/doc/five/ 提供 Rapfi 对应源码、构建脚本及许可证。

English
Play Gomoku offline on Cardputer Zero. Face Rapfi at one of three difficulty levels or take turns with a friend on the same device. Choose a 15×15 or 13×13 board and play with Freestyle or Renju fouls. Both modes support undo and resume. The interface and rules guide are available in Simplified Chinese and English.

What’s new (1.0.0-7)
Five automatically retries when Rapfi fails to return a move. For repeated failures, the delay grows from 0.5 seconds to 4 seconds. You can still undo or return to the menu while Five retries.

Five is proprietary. The separate Rapfi engine is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later and its official weights under CC0-1.0. Corresponding Rapfi source, build scripts and license texts are included in the package under /usr/share/doc/five/.
